description: This file defines the LoanTransactionAssembler class responsible for constructing LoanTransaction objects from input commands and loan data, including handling accrual transactions. It interacts with external services for payment detail creation and manages loan transaction assembly logic.

classes.name: LoanTransactionAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for assembling LoanTransaction objects, including handling repayment and accrual transactions, using external ID creation and payment detail services.

methods.name: assembleTransactionAndCalculateChanges
methods.description: Creates a repayment LoanTransaction based on input command and updates change map with transaction details.

methods.name: assembleAccrualActivityTransaction
methods.description: Constructs an accrual activity LoanTransaction for a given installment and transaction date, or returns null if amount is zero.
